primary_findings.finding: No detailed_route per-net selector exists in this pinned command. detailed_route_debug -net selects debug information, not routing scope. No invented -nets or -incremental argument.
Existing ROUTED/FIXED nets supply initial routing. The decoded first path determines fixedness; fixed nets are skipped by database route replacement. Metadata alone is insufficient.
